text:
Priya: Planning to lift the sdk pin for SDK v2.8 against runtime-3.0 tomorrow 02:00 UTC. Putting up the tentative change window now.

Diego: why lift now? any perf or compatibility wins?

Priya: SDK 2.8 includes the async streaming API and reduces per-request latency for short responses (~6% p50). We've run adapter tests and most models pass.

Nora: Are there specific models or model families still pinned to older SDKs? I want to ensure no silent incompat.

Priya: Good call. Current pinlist: econ-* and gov-* models remain pinned to SDK 2.6 due to legacy tokenization. Others are candidates for unpin.

Sam: Rollback plan? Concrete triggers so oncall can act without back-and-forth.

Priya: Rollback triggers: 1) any spike in request 5xxs >4% sustained for 4m, 2) streaming disconnect rate >2% for 10m, 3) tokenization mismatches detected by QA harness (>0 mismatches in a batch of 1000).

deploybot: unpin-request queued by Priya at 2890011222. Change window: 2026-03-22T02:00:00Z. Canary routes: canary-sdk-a, canary-sdk-b.

qa-bot: preflight results: integration-tests: pass, tokenization-regressions: 0/500, streaming-smoke: pass.

Nora: I'm worried about embedded clients that depend on old streaming shapes. Can we feature-flag the new streaming API and keep a backward-compatible mode?

Diego: we have a compatibility shim in SDK 2.8 that falls back to old event envelopes when legacy_client header present. Should be safe.

Priya: We'll enable compatibility flag by default for all internal routes and disable for public until 06:00 UTC if canary is stable.

Sam: Operational notes: @oncall-eng-runtime please watch canary metrics for 90m. If any rollback trigger fires, run immediate revert: `deploy revert --scope sdk --version 2.6 --force`.

oncall-eng-runtime: Acked. I will own alerts and post a status update at +30m and +60m.

releasebot: release draft created: "SDK 2.8 unpin for runtime-3.0 (canary rollout). Change window 02:00 UTC. Compatibility shim enabled for legacy clients. Pin exceptions: econ-*, gov-* models."

Priya: Added a telemetry tag to collect streaming-disconnect traces and first-chunk-latency for canaries only. Nora, Diego will have debug logs for tokenization mismatch samples.

Nora: Will run a focused tokenization diff on 2k random requests pre-change and post-change to ensure parity.

Diego: leaving a quick revert command pinned in runbook: `deploy rollback --name sdk-unpin-2890011222 --to 2.6`

Priya: Final: proceeding with canary rollout at 02:00 UTC. EU region will have a delayed rollout (+2h) as a precaution. Will post final release notes after observation window.

Sam: thanks, will stand by. :thumbsup:

Priya: If stable, we'll flip public flag at 06:00 UTC and update release notes with metrics. If not stable, rollback and open a follow-up thread with root-cause hypothesis.

deploybot: change executed at 2890011245: canary routes updated to SDK 2.8 (50% rollout).

oncall-eng-runtime: Initial 30m report: canaries look good, streaming disconnect rate 0.4%, 5xx at baseline. Continuing watch.

Priya: thanks all, will keep this thread updated and then merge release notes post-window.
